title: 大家怎么利用 AI 学习英语？
excerpt: 问与答 - @fanglongzong - RT ，多邻国之类太贵了
content_html:
gpt 的语音模式很强，可以让他跟你聊。之前在推上看到的这段 prompt ，开一个会话贴进去， 然后开始语音模式，跟他聊就可以了

Hello, I am Chinese English learner and around B1 level. Please be my speaking partner, speak clearly and do not too fast. Ask only one question at a time. Do not interrupt me when I pause or make small mistakes. Only correct me after I say I am finished. Use Chinese only when I ask for help
